{{Short description|Italian mathematician and astronomer (1569-1638)}}
{{orphan|date=June 2017}}

[[File:Bruni - Armonia astronomica e geometrica, 1622 - 1230097.jpg |thumb|''Armonia astronomica e geometrica'', 1622]]

'''Teofilo Bruni''' ([[Verona]], 1569 - [[Vicenza]], 1638 ) was an Italian [[mathematician]] and [[astronomer]].<ref>{{cite web|url= https://thesaurus.cerl.org/cgi-bin/record.pl?rid=cnp02156711|title= Bruni, Teofilo (1569 - 1638) in CERL Thesaurus}}</ref>

== Life ==

Born in [[Verona]], he was a [[Order of Friars Minor Capuchin|capuchin friar]] known by the name of Raffaele.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://books.google.com/books?id=CdjYgMq2u3gC|title= Historia ecclesiastica della place, territorio, e diocese di Vicenza by Francesco Barbarano de' Mironi|last1= Mironi|first1= Francesco Barbarano de'|year= 1760}}</ref>
He wrote mainly about [[mathematics]] and [[astronomy]], but he also published a book about clocks and other tools based on mathematical concepts.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://books.google.com/books?id=4CA7OboytjIC|title= Verona illustrata by Scipione Maffei|last1= Maffei|first1= Marchese Scipione|year= 1731}}</ref>
